## Uncomfortable finding

The standalone code-interpreter, universal plugin, and topic-routed WebSocket
document sets described systems that are not shipped. They are now explicitly
historical and synthesis-only. Current UAR instead exposes in-process sandbox
tools, an unwired WASM loader contract, and entity-change SSE. Preserving those
documents without this distinction would have turned design intent into false
product documentation.

## Deferred evidence

Vale is absent, so prose lint is unverified. Production build, rendered visual
quality, keyboard behavior, accessibility, Pages deployment, live route status,
registry publication, runtime health, inference, migration, rollback, and
cross-profile behavior remain outside this content review.
